delivery: Source branch only. Root integrates final draft PR #516, full release validation and two fresh independent nonauthor reviews. No child PR, main merge or published review receipt.

full_frozen_oracle.name: Ironheart, Clever Champion
full_frozen_oracle.oracle_text:
Improvise (Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)
Flying
Noncreature spells you cast have improvise.

obligations.Improvise: Actual4U spell with four artifact credits; artifacts alone cannot payU; intrinsic plus granted instance redundant; generic only even with Vizier substitution.
obligations.Flying and3/4 legendary artifact Human H: Runtime characteristics, paid actual attack/ground-block illegality/3 damage, real legend choice preserving only new incarnation.
obligations.Noncreature spells you cast have improvi: Current source controller, suppression/removal/departure/redundancy; actual Divination payments; creature exclusion; qualified mana; ward/activation exclusion; supported Candy Grapple bargain restores grant before mana after sacrificing Witness Protection; actual and virtual provider departure.

shared_mechanics: Intrinsic has_improvise and layer-six SpellImprovise(Noncreature) provider, registered in the shared static-source index. Query actual caster/selected definition and current effective provider in actual and speculative worlds.

New actor-owned BeginImprovise/ChooseImproviser and optional ImproviseChoiceView; exact reservations never tap, make mana or emit events. Mana window closes first; combined Convoke and Improvise taps commit as one central tap_objects batch.

Raw generic-only credits precede actual mana substitution. Colored and explicitC always require eligible real mana or legitimate colored Convoke, never artifact credits. Artifact creatures are one matching resource across both methods.

Existing ordered cost transaction also handles simple additional costs with contributions. A grant may be lost/restored by paying earlier costs; actual selection rechecks the live grant and effective Artifact type. A contributor may subsequently be sacrificed as a nonmana cost.

Exact32-mask Hall feasibility rejects impossible mana clauses before helper assignment. A final mana clause uses exact matching directly; when later costs remain, successful original resource assignment/order walk is retained.

actual_changes: Optional actor-only improvise_choice payload and phase string

consumer_evidence: All 9 complete Rust and direct pinned Java bodies audited. All inherited rules executed and all 2,501 full trace structs preserved. Vote Out has paid actual mixed-method scenarios; Unexpected Assistance has focused coupled funding scenarios. Traces alone do not certify every remaining printed obligation.

rules.paraphrase: Improvise pays only generic from untapped controlled artifacts after total cost locked; not additional/alternative cost; redundant instances. Mana abilities precede cost payment, costs can otherwise be ordered.
MV unchanged; alternative/additional total first; cannot pay colored/C/ward; an artifact already tapped or sacrificed for mana cannot contribute; equipment and creature tap separately.
May tap an artifact for Improvise before sacrificing it as a nonmana additional cost. This differs from sacrifice to activate a mana ability, which precedes contributor tapping.

tests.checked_helper: assurance::big_helpers::checked: wrong actor/atomic snapshot, raw/index owned orphan, stale revision, restore/replay equality on each paid mutation.
tests.bounded_oracle: 294 small funding configurations; additional mixed-resource/departure matrices; ordered 0..3 and 40 artifact Hall cases with scalar u32::MAX generic requirements. Large case added only after fail-first matching; no allocation/OOM probe.

trace_proof.projection: Existing opt-in recorder changes only view.schema at 146; no field removal, no recorder changes, ordinary validation stays strict.

format: All authored changed Rust passes rustfmt --edition 2024 --check. Generated catalogue is checked byte-for-byte by link_catalogue.py --check and never manually reformatted.

source_audit.read_limits: Complete direct card classes and concrete reusable Improvise/payment/grant/tap/mana/filter/target helpers read. Whole generic engine/ManaPool/Spell files are retained with explicit relevant ranges, not represented as a full recursive runtime audit. No test/build/performance measurement executed.
